rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable but somewhat optimistic from a single static image; correctly notes visible cavity, thin zona, and probable ICM, but TE assessment is limited and calling it full/early expanded may not be precise from this image alone.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian response, prior IVF outcome, male factor, endometrium, BMI, lifestyle, and protocol with embryo quality and prognosis.

Logic is clear and internally consistent, especially around morphology versus age-related euploidy; only minor issue is some uncertainty in morphology while still giving a fairly confident quality interpretation.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET preference and caution about unproven add-ons; minor caveat is somewhat casual endorsement of PGT-A without fuller nuance on benefit limits.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including luteal support review, uterine cavity assessment, embryo cohort review, and male-factor follow-up if failures continue.
